items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: do you know he was another guy like William Ray Nance, we had to fight him to join Benny?

ctx.x: He'd Stand up and play and sell, and he won an audience immediately. He never had trouble getting a gaining a

fame thing. No matter what he played, they liked it. And Benny Goodman had heard about him and had wired his mother and father about where he was and they told him, but he gave his mother and father, naturally, his itinerary with me. (Inaudible). So he got a wire from Benny Goodman, and do you know he was another guy like William Ray Nance, we had to fight him to join Benny? He was having a ball. He didn't want to leave. So finally we convinced him that this was his big break. And whatnot. (Inaudible) he joined…

And he went on from there. Of course, he got a chance during later years to do his own thing. You know what happened from there on. Stan, this thing that he made was in the DownBeat, one of his solos -- da-da-da-da-da-dee-da-da, da-da-da-da --
